findings.title: claude-review.yml permanently fails without ANTHROPIC_API_KEY repo secret
findings.details: Job fires on every non-draft PR. Without the secret, anthropics/claude-code-action@v1 exits immediately. Confirmed failing on PR #51, check run 72971136054. Advisory (not a required check) but creates permanent red CI status.
findings.remediation: Option 1: Set ANTHROPIC_API_KEY repo secret. Option 2: Delete claude-review.yml and use local /review. Option 3: Change trigger to issue_comment only (/claude review) for opt-in behavior.

findings.remediation: No immediate action. If CLAUDE.md reaches 700+ lines, split domain sections into @.claude/context/ imports.
